description: This file is a shell script intended for verifying the installation and versioning of command-line interfaces (CLIs) within a Docker-related project. It checks if specified CLIs are installed, retrieves their versions, and compares against expected versions. It also sources an external script for version parsing.

methods.name: verify_installed_cli
methods.description: Verifies if a CLI is installed, checks its version against an expected value, and runs a help command to validate its operability.
